kaggle._username_note: Always null in git. Resolved at runtime from .env via scripts/env_setup.py so each teammate runs under their own Kaggle account.
kaggle._artifacts_note: Weights + processed cache persist as Kaggle kernel output and chain into the next run via kernel_sources. No Kaggle token is needed inside the notebook.

repair._note: A failed run routes on the submit agent's classification in orchestrator/handoff.json: dev_bug goes back to implement (same proposal), logic_error goes back to research (new proposal). Exhausting both parks the loop for a human.

anchors.note: Public LB is compromised by a test-set leak. Trust local OOF CV, not LB.

team._note: Kernels are namespaced per member; shared_memory/ is the single shared record. GITHUB_TOKEN is the only Kaggle Secret - the notebook needs it to clone the private repo. All Kaggle API calls run locally from .env.
